transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, I'm mainly here because I've been having a lot of trouble at work lately. I'm a hairstylist, and... it's just really hard to explain, but my hands feel like they’re moving through glue. Even doing simple things like sectioning hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever now. People at the salon have actually started noticing that I’m just a lot slower than I used to be.
Alongside this slowness, how has your mood been lately?

Honestly, my mood hasn't been good at all. Most days I just wake up with this... heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. It just feels like there’s no point in trying to build the life I was planning for myself.
Have you ever experienced times where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energized, full of ideas, or needing very little sleep?

No, not really. I don't think I've ever felt like that. I mean, I definitely need my sleep... if anything, I've just been feeling really drained lately, not energized at all. So, no, I haven't had times where I'm full of ideas or running on no sleep. I just haven't experienced that.

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had normal bad days before, but never anything like this. This heavy feeling where I can barely get through my shifts at the salon... it's completely new. So, no, I've never gone through a period where I felt this low before.
Have you noticed any involuntary shaking or trembling in your hands, particularly when you're resting them?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My hands are pretty steady, which is good since I need them for cutting hair. But yeah, no shaking or trembling when I'm just resting them.
Have you noticed being unusually sensitive to the cold lately, like feeling chilly even when others around you are comfortable?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, the salon can get a little drafty sometimes, but I don't feel any colder than anyone else. I haven't been unusually sensitive to it or anything.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It's been going on for about a year and eight months now. It started right after my hours were cut at the salon, and I just watched my savings start to drain away. That's when this all began.
Have you heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't see or hear?

Yeah, I have. Um, sometimes when I'm sweeping up or rinsing out the bowls, I hear a woman's voice. It usually sounds like it's coming from over by the shampoo stations. She tells me that I'm ruining everything. And the thing is, it happens even when the salon is completely empty, or when nobody is anywhere close by.
